subject.title: fix(security): add estimate-before-decode guard to base64 paths

question: Should OpenClaw enforce the existing generated-media byte limit per base64 image in OpenAI-compatible provider responses, accepting that a formerly decoded over-budget single image now becomes the existing missing-image failure?
rationale: The code and proof establish the behavior, but choosing between fail-closed per-image enforcement and preserving the older aggregate-only acceptance policy is a maintainer-owned security and compatibility decision.

options.title: Accept per-image enforcement
options.body: Merge the guard as defense-in-depth and treat mediaMaxMb as the maximum decoded size for each returned image.

options.title: Preserve aggregate-only acceptance
options.body: Pause this PR and define an alternative that prevents unsafe decode pressure without rejecting individual images previously accepted under the aggregate response budget.

recommendation.title: Accept per-image enforcement
recommendation.body: Merge the guard as defense-in-depth and treat mediaMaxMb as the maximum decoded size for each returned image.
